# Reviewed Cornell compatibility fixture

These existing project template/validator bytes are retained unchanged to test
the managed research renderer against a real format contract. They are test
fixtures, not executable runtime plug-ins or a new project installation.

- `cornell-note-template.md`: SHA-256 `143d7be4ea4d7e00fcc3067b7843939cdfe63e14d4dcf11411c99a52c8eb6a37`
- `validate_notes.py`: SHA-256 `052b08835e19d17fd06dc7450251926400dff960c0893ef9113cd07cf5e8b5e0`

The compatibility profile requires both fingerprints in declared approved skill
inputs and the frozen preservation baseline. It never selects a format from a
problem ID, repository directory or natural-language criterion.
